verifies.G071-C1: a mapper that carries custom logic (an @AfterMapping default method) is made to extend the generic EntityMapper<D, E> base by Make mapper extend generic base mapper: only the header gains `extends EntityMapper<WidgetDto, Widget>`, the @AfterMapping method and the imports stay byte-identical. The base mapper comes from the generic base action (preAction). That MapStruct honours the @AfterMapping in a generated implementation is not checked.
